Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning permanent parenting plans that are agreed to or entered into by default.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permanent parenting plans that are agreed to orentered into by default; and amending RCW 26.09.182.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.09.182 and 2007 c 496 s 304 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before entering a permanent parenting plan, the court shalldetermine the existence of any information and proceedings relevant tothe placement of the child that are available in the judicialinformation system and databases. Unless specifically requested by aparty, the foregoing shall not apply to agreed permanent parentingplans or those entered into by default.
